captions.detailed: A 3D model of a historic naval carronade mounted on a wooden deck platform. The assembly features a dark cast-iron barrel resting on a wooden carriage bed, which is supported by a slide rail base. The barrel can rotate vertically on its trunnions, the carriage can slide back and forth along the guide rails to simulate recoil, and the entire slide base can traverse horizontally around a vertical pivot pin on the deck.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a naval carronade with a short, stubby cast-iron barrel. It should be mounted on a sliding carriage bed that recoils along a wooden slide rail base, with the entire assembly pivoting on a deck platform for horizontal traversing.
captions.factory: Construct a deck platform using a wide, flat box primitive. Create the slide rail base with parallel longitudinal beams and cross-members, anchoring it to the deck with a vertical pivot pin cylinder. Model the sliding carriage using vertical side plates and cross-braces, and place it on the slide rails. Finally, build the carronade barrel by combining concentric cylinders of varying diameters, adding a hollow bore, and attaching lateral trunnion cylinders that rest in the carriage's revolute joint sockets.
